newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates plunge at close on operation.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates plunge at close on operation.

text.p: Pakistan's money market rates plunged towards close on Thursday on a special open market operation by the State (central) Bank of Pakistan, dealers said.
"The market liquidity increased by the inflow of about 3.85 billion rupees as a result of the maturity of a previous open market operation, putting pressure on overnight rates," one dealer said.

Dealers said early deals ranged from 8.0 to 15 percent despite Thursday's operation, but the rates plunged when the SBP announced its results. The SBP again reduced its yield to 16.70 percent from 16.95 in its special operation.
Term repos remained quiet as borrowers kept to the sidelines because of the liquid conditions, the dealers said.
